description: Open a skill by slug (from start, search_skills or search_rules) to answer the user's question. Returns the skill's rules and method, its quality tier, the named accountant where one reviewed it, a `section_index` of sections not inlined, and a provenance footer to keep with the answer.

reason.description: One sentence on WHY you're making this call, in the user's terms (for routing analysis only). Optional.

name: get_skill

approval.description: Current public professional approval. Use label verbatim; source/fact checks do not grant approval.

label.description: Approved by [name], or Not yet approved.

current_version.description: Current version. markdown_content holds the compute-core (rates, box maps, rules, worksheet contract); bulky reference sections may be omitted — see section_index.

key_facts.description: Optional at-a-glance facts (rates/thresholds/deadlines/verifier/advisory) — present only where the skill carries a structured key_facts block; omitted otherwise.

last_verified_at.description: When the skill's facts were last verified (decay signal), or null if never.

tier.description: Legacy routing value. Use approval.label for current professional approval; this does not certify fact currency.

required_facts.description: Intake skills only: the questions a professional asks before computing, verbatim from the skill. Answer from what the user said or data you hold, then ask the rest grouped, before any figure.

section_index.description: Every section of the skill with {index, heading, level, chars, priority, included}. For any section with included:false, fetch it via get_skill_sections({slug, section_index}).

skill.description: The published skill record. tier is 1 for current public professional approval, otherwise 2; use approval.label for the public status.

verification.description: Recorded fact-check counts and dates only, not professional approval. Use approval.label for the skill's approval status.

written_by.description: The accountant who wrote this skill ({name, profile_url}), when a named approved accountant authored it; null otherwise.

title: Read a tax skill
